title: Secrets and Easter Eggs
description: Easter eggs, random encounters, unmarked places, rare items and tricks. Much of it comes from the MrCatGame video "10 hours of Skyrim secrets", checked against UESP.

items.title: Arrow in the Knee
items.location: Guards in any city
items.description: Guards sigh: "I used to be an adventurer like you. Then I took an arrow in the knee." The line became one of the game's biggest memes.

items.title: Sweetroll
items.location: Guards in any city
items.description: A guard may ask: "Let me guess... someone stole your sweetroll." It nods to the sweetroll question asked during character creation in early games of the series.

items.title: M'aiq the Liar
items.location: Random encounter on the roads of Skyrim
items.description: A Khajiit wanderer who has turned up in the series since Morrowind. His lines are jokes about the game itself and its mechanics.
tips: You can't trade with him or hire him, only talk.

items.title: Bucket on the Head
items.location: Any merchant
items.description: Put a bucket or basket over a merchant's head (by dragging the item) and they can no longer see you, so you can clean out the counter in peace. A famous quirk of Skyrim's physics.

items.title: Number of the Beast
items.location: Quest "The Cure for Madness" (Dark Brotherhood)
items.description: The quest stage where Shadowmere rises from the pool is numbered 666, the "number of the beast". It is only visible in the game data.

items.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back
items.location: Bleakcoast Cave, Winterhold Hold
items.description: A skeleton hangs upside down from the ceiling with a glowing sword below it, like Luke Skywalker in the cave on Hoth.

items.title: Poltergeist
items.location: Markarth, abandoned house (quest "The House of Horrors")
items.description: When you first enter, the chairs stack themselves into a pyramid, as in the 1982 film Poltergeist.

items.title: Indiana Jones
items.location: Jorrvaskr, Athis
items.description: Asked why he joined the Companions, Athis replies: "Fortune and glory, friend. Fortune and glory." A line from Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom.

items.title: The Shawshank Redemption
items.location: College of Winterhold, Enthir
items.description: You can tell Enthir: "I understand you're an elf who knows how to get things." A nod to The Shawshank Redemption.

items.title: The Hangover
items.location: Quest "A Night to Remember"
items.description: Sanguine's whole Daedric quest is about piecing together a drunken night from the mess you left behind, just like The Hangover.

items.title: Annie
items.location: Riften, Honorhall Orphanage (quest "Innocence Lost")
items.description: Grelod the Kind makes the orphans thank her for her kindness in chorus, like Miss Hannigan in the musical Annie.

items.title: Star Trek: TNG — Darmok
items.location: Ivarstead, sawmill
items.description: The sawmill owner's name nods to the Star Trek: The Next Generation episode "Darmok", with its repeated line "Temba, his arms wide."

items.title: Interview with the Vampire
items.location: Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary
items.description: Babette, a vampire in a child's body, references Anne Rice's Interview with the Vampire: the name comes from Babette, the look from Claudia.

items.title: Lady of the Lake
items.location: Northeast of Bleakwind Basin, Whiterun Hold
items.description: A skeletal arm holding a sword sticks out of a small pond, a nod to the Lady of the Lake and Excalibur from Arthurian legend.

items.title: Sword in the Stone
items.location: Rebel's Cairn, south of Broken Tower Redoubt
items.description: A sword is stuck in the top of a pile of rocks, another Arthurian reference.

items.title: Three Billy Goats Gruff
items.location: Bridge south of Markarth, near Purewater Run
items.description: A dead troll lies under the bridge, and three goats meet on the bridge and run off together, as in the fairy tale Three Billy Goats Gruff.

items.title: Alice in Wonderland
items.location: Quest "The Mind of Madness"
items.description: Sheogorath and Emperor Pelagius have tea in the middle of a forest, like the Mad Tea Party in Alice in Wonderland.

items.title: William Tell
items.location: Swindler's Den
items.description: An apple sits on the head of an archery training dummy, a nod to the legend of William Tell.

items.title: The White Tree of Gondor
items.location: Whiterun
items.description: The Gildergreen, a withering offshoot of the ancient Eldergleam in the center of town, is restored by the hero, a parallel to the White Tree of Minas Tirith in The Lord of the Rings.

items.title: Headless Horseman
items.location: Roads of Whiterun Hold at night, ending at Hamvir's Rest
items.description: A ghostly headless rider gallops at night and vanishes at the ancient graveyard of Hamvir's Rest, a reference to The Legend of Sleepy Hollow.

items.title: Notched Pickaxe
items.location: Summit of the Throat of the World
items.description: A unique pickaxe that boosts Smithing, a shout-out to Markus "Notch" Persson and Minecraft.
tips: The pickaxe is stuck in a rock at the very top. Check the stones around you.

items.title: Pac-Man
items.location: Markarth, Endon's House, back room
items.description: Cheese, a slaughterfish egg, garlic and glow dust on a shelf are arranged into a Pac-Man scene.

items.title: The Legend of Zelda
items.location: Quest "Proving Honor", Farkas
items.description: When revealing that the Circle of the Companions are werewolves, Farkas says "It's a secret to everybody," the famous line from the first Legend of Zelda.

items.title: Embershard Mine
items.location: Road from Helgen to Riverwood
items.description: The mine's name is a pun on the Ambershard dwarf clan from a Dungeons & Dragons podcast with the creators of Penny Arcade.

items.title: Erik the Slayer
items.location: Rorikstead, Frostfruit Inn
items.description: Erik is a tribute to gamer Erik West, known online as "ImmoktheSlayer".

items.title: Katatonia
items.location: Pilgrim's Path (quest "Darkness Returns")
items.description: Nystrom's Journal references the Swedish band Katatonia, whose guitarist is Anders Nyström.

items.title: Castlevania II
items.location: Castle Volkihar, room left of the great hall (Dawnguard)
items.description: A display case holds a hagraven claw, a sabre cat eye, a daedra heart, a dog's ribcage and a ring, like Dracula's body parts in Castlevania II.

items.title: The Lusty Riekling
items.location: Benkongerike, Solstheim (Dragonborn)
items.description: A riekling hut is stuffed with copies of The Lusty Argonian Maid, the series' signature dirty joke.

items.title: A Song of Ice and Fire
items.location: Markarth, Cidhna Mine exit
items.description: If you kill Madanach and escape alone, Thonar Silver-Blood says "The Silver-Bloods pay their debts," a play on the Lannister motto "A Lannister always pays his debts."

items.title: Snow White
items.location: Blackreach, Dwemer barracks
items.description: A bedroom has seven small beds and one large one, a nod to Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.

items.title: The Drunken Dare
items.location: Roads of Skyrim after the quest "A Night to Remember"
items.description: Deep-In-His-Cups, an Argonian you drunkenly dared to steal a "great artifact", catches up with you and demands 10,000 gold for it.
tips: You can pay, haggle for less or refuse

items.title: Companions Hunting
items.location: Skyrim wilderness
items.description: A Companions party hunts a beast: Farkas, Athis and Torvar hunt a bear; Skjor, Aela and Njada Stonearm hunt a mammoth (Eastmarch); Vilkas and Ria hunt a sabre cat.
tips: Happens before "Take Up Arms" or after "Glory of the Dead"
Farkas's trio never appears in Whiterun Hold
They attack if you're in Vampire Lord form

items.title: Taron Dreth's Revenge
items.location: Roads of Skyrim after the quest "Lost to the Ages"
items.description: The Dunmer Taron Dreth tracks you down and demands to know where you got an Aetherium item forged at the Dwemer forge. Whatever you say, it ends in a fight.

items.title: Telrav's Request
items.location: Crossroads east of Ivarstead, by a ransacked cart; camp: Nilheim
items.description: Telrav, a "robbed merchant", asks you to escort him to a safe camp at Nilheim. In fact he leads a bandit gang and walks you into an ambush.
tips: Telrav spelled backwards is "varlet", a scoundrel

items.title: Dead Treasure Hunter
items.location: Skyrim wilderness
items.description: A dead treasure hunter carries a note about a dungeon with a hidden enchanted weapon. Reading the note marks the dungeon on your map.
tips: The weapon is leveled, so the dungeon is worth clearing

items.title: Wizard Duel
items.location: Skyrim wilderness
items.description: A fire mage and a frost mage are locked in a deadly duel. The winner usually attacks you too.

items.title: Alik'r Accusation
items.location: Roads of Skyrim during the quest "In My Time of Need"
items.description: Two Alik'r warriors question a Redguard woman, mistaking her for the fugitive they're hunting. Afterwards you can talk to her, and she starts the quest if you don't have it yet.

items.title: Vigilants Patrol
items.location: Roads of Skyrim
items.description: Two Vigilants of Stendarr patrol the roads or head to the Hall of the Vigilant. Ask who they are and the Hall of the Vigilant is marked on your map.
tips: Due to a bug, they may turn hostile if you heal them or cast beneficial illusion spells on them

items.title: Drinking Companions
items.location: Roads of Skyrim
items.description: Three revelers recognize the Dragonborn and offer a drink. Their response depends on which mead you carry.
tips: Have Honningbrew Mead? Give it to them for an enchanted necklace
They scorn Black-Briar Mead
With no mead, they give you a bottle

items.title: College Application Denied
items.location: Skyrim wilderness, level 15+
items.description: An aspiring mage tries to reanimate a dead animal. Talking to him can get you his reanimation staff.
tips: Requires level 15

items.title: Dawnguard Novice Hakar
items.location: Roads of Skyrim at night (midnight to 8 AM)
items.description: Hakar, a Dawnguard recruit, fights off vampires. If he survives, he drops his gear, a Dawnguard Cache Key and a list of caches, then runs away.
tips: If Hakar dies, take the key and orders from his body
Requires "The Bloodstone Chalice" or "A New Order" completed

items.title: The Painted Cow
items.location: Roads of Eastmarch and Whiterun Hold
items.description: A farmer leads a painted cow to a giant camp: a yearly offering so the giants leave his livestock alone. Later you may meet a giant leading such a cow home.
tips: Keep your distance from the procession: the giants may mistake you for part of the offering

items.title: Imperials vs Stormcloaks
items.location: Roads of Skyrim
items.description: Three Legion soldiers and three Stormcloaks fight each other. You can join in or just watch.
tips: Attacking either side may earn you a bounty in that hold

items.title: Wizard Duel (Challenger)
items.location: Cities and settlements
items.description: A rival mage walks up to you in a settlement and challenges you to a wizard duel. He won't take no for an answer and attacks anyway.
tips: Appears once any magic school (except Enchanting) reaches 50

items.title: Skooma Dealer
items.location: Roads of Skyrim
items.description: A dealer offers to help you "relax" with some skooma. Question the legality of the goods and he attacks.
tips: You can try to intimidate him, but failure means a fight
Gold spent on skooma won't be on his corpse

items.title: Pilgrim to the Gildergreen
items.location: Roads to Whiterun after the quest "The Blessings of Nature"
items.description: Ardwen, a Wood Elf, travels to Whiterun with her dog to pay respects to the reborn Gildergreen.
tips: Only happens if the Gildergreen was restored

items.title: Namira Cultist Offers the First Bite
items.location: Skyrim wilderness after the quest "The Taste of Death"
items.description: Sigar, a Nord, feasts on the body of a High Elf woman and offers you the first bite.

items.title: Vampires Fighting Bandits
items.location: Skyrim wilderness, 10 PM to 5 AM or during an eclipse
items.description: Three vampires fight three bandits. The winners then attack you.

items.title: Finding the Gourmet
items.location: Roads of Skyrim after the quest "Recipe for Disaster"
items.description: Balbus, a Nord cook, is searching for the famous Gourmet. Prove you are the Gourmet and he gives you a fork and rare ingredients.
tips: You need the Gourmet's Writ of Passage from "Recipe for Disaster" as proof

items.title: On the Way to the Wedding
items.location: Roads to Solitude
items.description: Plautis and Salonia Carvain travel with a bodyguard to Vittoria Vici's wedding. After "Bound Until Death" you may meet them again: they got lost and missed the ceremony.
tips: You can rob them like a highwayman: they carry expensive jewelry and gems, but it means a fight

items.title: Dragon Attack Aftermath
items.location: Roads of Skyrim after the quest "Dragon Rising"
items.description: Three burnt corpses lie by a wrecked cart with a surviving dog; the dragon may still be nearby. The cart holds a loot chest.
tips: The dog can become your follower

items.title: Dwemer Junk Peddlers
items.location: Roads of the Reach
items.description: Two kids, Sond and Bottar, try to sell Dwemer junk. For 1 gold they'll show where they found it, marking Deep Folk Crossing on your map.

items.title: A Good Death
items.location: Skyrim wilderness, level 5+
items.description: An old Orc stands by two dead sabre cats and asks you to give him a good death in battle. You can fight him or walk away.

items.title: Babette on the Road
items.location: Roads of Skyrim, 10 PM to 5 AM
items.description: Babette of the Dark Brotherhood feeds on a dead traveler right by the road.
tips: Only after the quest "Hail Sithis!"

items.title: Dark Brotherhood Assassin
items.location: Roads of Skyrim, level 5+
items.description: A Dark Brotherhood assassin attacks you. His body carries a contract, but the client is never named or revealed.
tips: Happens until "With Friends Like These..." is done or the Brotherhood is destroyed
The assassin's armor can't be taken

The basement of Black-Briar Manor holds a Black Sacrament and Maven's letter to Astrid about an unfulfilled contract. The video's author links them to the assassin, but the game never names the target

items.title: Vampire Assassin
items.location: Skyrim wilderness after the quest "A New Order"
items.description: A vampire assassin with orders to execute you. The writ marks the vampire lair she came from on your map.

items.title: Black Book
items.location: Solstheim
items.description: A madman raves about a Black Book and attacks. The encounter starts a quest to find one of the Black Books.
tips: Happens while not all Black Books are collected

items.title: Bats!
items.location: Skyrim wilderness, 10 PM to 5 AM
items.description: A swarm of bats flies at you. The encounter is harmless.
tips: Appears after the quest "Dawnguard" starts

items.title: Ramblings of a Madwoman
items.location: Roads of Skyrim
items.description: A mad old woman thanks you for helping Sheogorath and asks you to hit her with the Wabbajack.
tips: Dialogue differs before "The Mind of Madness" is complete

items.title: Scavenger
items.location: Skyrim wilderness
items.description: A scavenger loots the bodies of Legion soldiers and Stormcloaks after a skirmish. Get too close and he attacks.

items.title: Afflicted Refugee
items.location: Roads of Skyrim, level 10+
items.description: An Afflicted refugee fleeing to High Rock tells you about Peryite. After the talk, the Shrine of Peryite is marked on your map.
tips: Only before the quest "The Only Cure" starts

items.title: Magic Student
items.location: Any settlement except Orc strongholds
items.description: A young mage rejected by the College wants to apply again and asks you to show him a ward spell.
tips: You need a ward spell
He rewards you with a few scrolls

items.title: Werewolves
items.location: Skyrim wilderness, 10 PM to 5 AM
items.description: Two werewolves attack you in the middle of the night. Variants exist: a hunter who turns into a beast, and a werewolf husband who kills his wife.
tips: Only after the quest "Proving Honor"

items.title: Stolen Family Heirloom
items.location: Skyrim wilderness
items.description: A murdered woman lies on the ground with a note: bandits robbed her home and took a family pendant, she went after them and died. Two bandits are nearby, one of them holding the pendant.
tips: The pendant's enchantment is random: in the video it was +15% fire resistance

items.title: Dragon Fly-By
items.location: Skies of Skyrim after the quest "Dragon Rising"
items.description: A dragon flies overhead, sometimes hunting animals, but never attacks or lands. Hurt it and it gets angry, but it only lands if hit with Dragonrend.
tips: To fight it on the ground, keep Dragonrend ready and keep shouting it

items.title: Vampire Masquerade
items.location: Roads of Skyrim at night, 10 PM to 5 AM (Dawnguard)
items.description: Three "Vigilants of Stendarr" call out to you and attack at once. They are really vampires who killed the real Vigilants and took their robes; the stripped bodies lie nearby.

items.title: Fake Imperial Soldiers
items.location: Roads of Skyrim
items.description: Three "Imperial soldiers" led by an Orc say you're interfering with Imperial business and demand a 100 gold fine. They are bandits in the uniforms of murdered legionnaires, whose bodies lie nearby.
tips: You can pay, or if you serve the Legion or the Stormcloaks, expose or mock them
Any answer other than paying leads to a fight

items.title: Thief at the Door
items.location: Skyrim cities, at night from 10 PM to 4 AM
items.description: Guards catch a thief picking the lock of a house and try to kill him. Help the guards or just search the body: thieves often carry gems, gold and other loot to sell.
tips: Only after the quest "A Chance Arrangement" and at level 5+
If the thief runs into a house or shop, the guards won't follow, and the merchant won't trade until the thief is dealt with

items.title: Frossel Bandit
items.location: Solstheim wilderness (Dragonborn)
items.description: A lone reaver mutters that everyone is dead and the treasure is gone. Talk to him and he lets slip the loot was stolen from Frossel, then attacks, and Frossel is marked on your map. There rieklings killed his gang, and the loot (jewelry, gems and silver ingots) sits in their lair.
tips: You'll have to kill the rieklings in the cave anyway

items.title: Pilgrim to Azura's Shrine
items.location: Roads of Skyrim
items.description: Faldrus, a Dunmer, is on a pilgrimage to the Shrine of Azura. Ask where it is and he marks it on your map, letting you start "The Black Star".

items.title: Revenge for Malyn Varen
items.location: Roads of Skyrim after the quest "The Black Star"
items.description: Two necromancers (one a Dark Elf) track you down and attack. One carries a scrawled note: Malyn Varen's death will not go unpunished; find the owner of Azura's Star and take revenge.
tips: They can be novices or adepts: their level scales with yours

items.title: Disguised Vampire Lord
items.location: Cities and settlements after the quest "A New Order" (Dawnguard)
items.description: An ordinary-looking traveler approaches you, reveals himself as a vampire, summons a gargoyle and attacks right in the middle of town.
tips: Fight near the guards: they'll help
His body makes a strong servant for Dead Thrall

items.title: Sinding Roaming
items.location: Around Bloated Man's Grotto, Falkreath and Whiterun, if you spared Sinding
items.description: If you spare Sinding in "Ill Met by Moonlight", he stays a werewolf for good and sometimes roams the roads between Bloated Man's Grotto, Riverwood and Falkreath, attacking your enemies. Nobody around notices him.
tips: When you meet, he may say he didn't expect to see you again

items.title: Knifepoint Archer
items.en: Тайник лучника на Хребте Остриё Ножа
items.location: Knifepoint Ridge, Falkreath Hold: the cliff west-southwest of the camp, above the mine entrance
items.description: Climb the tall rock outcrop above the bandit camp to find a skeleton with a bloodied leveled bow and a knapsack with common loot.
tips: The climb is steep: look for ledges and jump from rock to rock
The bow is leveled, so it is weaker at low levels

items.title: Reachman's Altar: Red Eagle Redoubt
items.location: Above the entrance to Red Eagle Redoubt, the Reach
items.description: On a ledge above the redoubt entrance stand the ruins of an old altar: a stone table, a throne and an unlocked chest with leveled loot. There is a silver ore vein nearby.
tips: The easiest way up is the wooden ladder to the Forsworn lookout by the entrance, then up the slope to the right

items.title: River Island
items.location: A river islet northeast of Swindler's Den and southwest of Greenspring Hollow, Whiterun Hold (near Rorikstead)
items.description: Among the mudcrabs on the islet lie a mammoth skeleton and a warrior's remains: a skull wearing a helmet. The helmet is leveled: at level 20+ it can be elven or glass. There is also an iron ore vein and a nirnroot.
tips: Don't rush to take it: the higher your level, the better the helmet

items.title: Daughter of the Niben Nook
items.location: Between Haemar's Shame and the Alchemist's Shack, on the pass from Helgen to the Rift
items.description: By the mountain road a small pile of rocks marks a steep, narrow path east into a rock crevice. At the end are a quicksilver ore vein and the skill book Daughter of the Niben (+1 Alteration).
tips: You will have to jump across rocks on the path

items.title: Reachwind Burial Mound
items.location: Hilltop east of Dushnikh Yal, the Reach
items.description: An open Nordic barrow with a collapsed entrance. Inside are a table with embalming tools, an urn, a chest with a Smithing skill book, and under the rocks a skeleton clutching a coin purse: a treasure hunter who never made it out.
tips: The skill book is always there: take it for +1 Smithing

items.title: The Exposed Miner
items.location: East of Broken Tower Redoubt, down the cliff to the left of the road, the Reach
items.description: A miner's remains lie on a corundum ore vein. Further down the slope is a wrecked cart with spilled books, including the skill book The Legendary Sancre Tor (Two-handed).

items.title: Sabre Cat Rock
items.location: West of Robber's Gorge, between Broken Tower Redoubt and Robber's Gorge, the Reach
items.description: A lair of two sabre cats on a rock ringed by stone pillars. Around it lie their victims: a Nord and two hunters. One hunter always carries the skill book 2920, Morning Star, v1 (One-handed).
tips: The hunter's corpse with the book respawns

items.title: The Wolf Queen Stash
items.location: South of Snow Veil Sanctum and west of Yngol Barrow, near Windhelm
items.description: A stash is hidden in the bushes among snowy trees: a coin purse and the skill book The Wolf Queen, v1 (Lockpicking).

items.title: Shrine of Talos: Watcher of Windhelm
items.location: Shrine of Talos "Watcher of Windhelm" on a rock south-southwest of Windhelm, west of the stables
items.description: The shrine has offerings to Talos and the book The Talos Mistake, but the real find is a dead Thalmor under the small bridge to it, always carrying an enchanted weapon. The weapon is leveled and the enchantment is random.
tips: A frozen flag seen from afar usually marks an unmarked place
Come at a high level and save first: you can reload for an ebony weapon with the enchantment you want

items.title: White Cap Circle
items.location: Falkreath Hold, north of the Twilight Sepulcher entrance, near the border with the Reach
items.description: A clearing where mushrooms grow in a perfect ring, like a real fairy ring. On the way there, at the border with the Reach, is a dried-up pond with an animal skeleton at the bottom.

items.title: Forgotten Spoils
items.location: Solstheim, northwest of Hrothmund's Barrow, in the mountains above a waterfall
items.description: High in the mountains near ore veins and gem geodes, if you climb down and turn around, there is a chest with good loot. The author found enchanted items and rings there. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Ruins near Honeystrand Cave
items.location: The Rift, southeast of Honeystrand Cave (by the road south of Ivarstead)
items.description: Small ruins guarded by a bear. Nearby lies the skill book Lord Jornibret's Last Dance (+1 Light Armor). Leveled light armor also appears there, up to Dragonscale (from the video, unverified).
tips: The higher your level, the more valuable the armor

items.title: Hagraven Camp: Ragnvald Scree
items.location: The Reach, south of the Nordic ruins of Ragnvald, high in the mountains
items.description: A grim camp with heads on stakes and bloody remains. It is empty at first, but once you enter the tent the hagraven comes back. The tent holds a locked chest with leveled loot.
tips: Get ready to fight before entering the tent: the hagraven heals herself

items.title: Haul of the Horkers
items.location: Winterhold Hold, a steep trail to the sea north-northeast of Journeyman's Nook
items.description: At the bottom of the trail two horkers guard a rock alcove with a victim's remains. It holds a locked chest and the skill book 2920, Rain's Hand, v4 (+1 Restoration). There is a silver ore vein nearby.

items.title: Bear Hunter's Camp
items.location: Falkreath Hold, north of Halldir's Cairn
items.description: An abandoned camp with a cold campfire. On a crate lie a Hunter's Journal and the skill book Legend of Krately House (+1 Sneak). The bear den from the journal is a bit higher up the slope, and the hunters' bodies lie there.
tips: Read the journal, then climb to the den: their gear is there

items.title: Proper Lock Design near Darklight Tower
items.en: Книга у берёзы за Башней Светотьмы
items.location: The Rift, top of Darklight Tower: west of the gate at the exit to the top, by a fallen birch
items.description: Next to a fallen birch that looks like it has a stash mark scratched on it, there is always the skill book Proper Lock Design (+1 Lockpicking).
tips: The exit to the top opens as you go through Darklight Tower

items.title: Avalanche Pass
items.location: Winterhold Hold, the mountain path from Whistling Mine to the Shrine of Azura (near Fort Kastav)
items.description: An avalanche buried three refugees with a loaded wagon. In the wreckage are a coin purse, an apothecary's satchel, a leveled battleaxe and the skill book Enchanter's Primer (+1 Enchanting).
tips: According to the video, a rockslide starts further along the path, and on high difficulty the rocks are very dangerous (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Fisherman's Camp: Slaughterfish Bay
items.location: Winterhold Hold, northwest of the Wreck of the Winter War
items.description: An empty fishing camp holds a Fisherman's Journal: two friends went fishing and drinking. Their skeletons lie underwater by a capsized boat a little east of the camp, in slaughterfish-infested water. Under the boat are a sack, a coin purse and a random weapon.
tips: Flame Cloak is handy for keeping slaughterfish away

items.title: Julianos's Fallen
items.location: The Pale, north of Shearpoint, above Tumble Arch Pass (a giant camp below)
items.description: A half-buried skeleton hugs a portable Shrine of Julianos, as if it carried the shrine and never made it. The shrine works: the Blessing of Julianos gives +25 Magicka.
tips: Useful for a mage early on, when Magicka is low

items.title: Alchemist's Camp: Evergreen Woods
items.location: Falkreath Hold, upstream and north of Evergreen Grove
items.description: An abandoned camp with a cooking pot, the skill book De Rerum Dirennis (+1 Alchemy), an apothecary's satchel and an alchemist's journal. Blood-red crown grows around, and there is a nirnroot upstream. The alchemist himself lies dead below in Evergreen Grove, home to spriggans.
tips: Read the journal, then go downstream to see how the story ended

items.title: Last Scabbard of Akrash near Black-Briar Lodge
items.location: The Rift, south-southeast of Black-Briar Lodge
items.description: In an inconspicuous stone niche near the lodge there is always the skill book Last Scabbard of Akrash (+1 Smithing). The video author also found rawhide armor there, at any level (from the video, unverified).

items.title: Dunmeri Camp
items.location: Solstheim, far north of the Sun Stone, southwest of Bujold's Retreat
items.description: A camp where rieklings killed two Dark Elves. The chests are empty, but the tent holds an East Empire Company strongbox and bottles of Nord mead. Rieklings hide nearby and attack when you approach.
tips: The strongbox may hold gems and an East Empire Pendant

items.title: Yisra's Beachside Combustion
items.location: The Pale, coast east of Dawnstar, south of Yngvild
items.description: The burned body of Yisra, a College student, lies in a circle of scorched ground. In front of her is Spell Tome: Flame Cloak: it seems she botched the spell. Her body carries Yisra's Necklace and a little gold.
tips: The fire around the body is real and damages you, your follower and your horse
Yisra is one of Phinis Gestor's missing apprentices; their quest was never finished, and returning the necklace does nothing

items.title: Dawnstar Frost Troll Den
items.location: The Pale, west of Dawnstar
items.description: A dangerous frost troll den with an unlocked chest and the skill book Death Blow of Abernanit (+1 Block).
tips: Use fire or fight the troll from range

items.title: Shoreline Bandit Camp
items.location: The Pale, west of Dawnstar, under a rock ledge by the sea
items.description: Three bandits have camped by the sea. There is a chest and the skill book A Hypothetical Treachery (+1 Destruction).
tips: A small strongbox is hidden in the bushes near the pools of blood (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Shrine of Akatosh: Rorikstead
items.location: Whiterun Hold, the hill directly north of the Frostfruit Inn in Rorikstead
items.description: Under fallen pillars stands a Shrine of Akatosh (Magicka regenerates 10% faster). Nearby are a blue dartwing, a dragon scale and the book Kolb & the Dragon. This is the only place to get a dragon scale before the quest Dragon Rising.
tips: Kolb & the Dragon is a choose-your-own-adventure gamebook, worth reading

items.title: Clam Digger's Camp
items.location: Haafingar, on the Sea of Ghosts coast southwest of Northwatch Keep
items.description: An abandoned camp with a tent and a bedroll you can sleep in. A crate by the fire holds 16 clam meat, and about 19 clams grow on a nearby rock. A handy place to stock up on clam meat for cooking.
tips: The tent and campfire come in handy in Survival Mode

items.title: Burning Farmhouse
items.location: The Rift, south of Forelhost, east of Lost Tongue Overlook
items.description: A house that is always on fire. By the entrance a burnt corpse holds a Scroll of Conjure Flame Atronach next to a ring of candles: the ritual clearly went wrong. Leeks grow in the garden, and a hollow log by the north corner of the house holds the skill book The Horror of Castle Xyr (+1 Destruction).
tips: The Horror of Castle Xyr is one of the most interesting plays in the game, worth reading

items.title: Dead Redguard
items.location: The Rift, northeast of Angarvunde and east of Heartwood Mill
items.description: A dead Redguard lies over a tree stump, with the skill book Advances in Lockpicking (+1 Lockpicking) underneath him.

items.title: Hunter's Camp: Sulphur Soaking Pools
items.location: Eastmarch, southwest of Eldergleam Sanctuary, among the geysers
items.description: Three half-dressed hunters relax with wine in a hot sulphur pool. On a table by a barrel lies the skill book Cherim's Heart (+1 Smithing).
tips: Don't touch their clothes or gear: the hunters attack if you steal

items.title: Shrine of Talos: Ilinalta Foothills
items.location: Falkreath Hold, southwest of the Guardian Stones, in the foothills by Lake Ilinalta
items.description: Slain pilgrims and a dead Thalmor Justiciar lie by the Shrine of Talos. It seems he came to destroy the shrine, killed everyone and died himself. He wears random enchanted armor.
tips: One of the first finds you can reach near Helgen

items.title: Khajiit Caravan Massacre
items.location: Falkreath Hold, on the road past the turn to Orphan Rock, east of Helgen
items.description: A wrecked caravan with dead Khajiit and horses. It's an ambush: bandits attack as you approach. The far cart holds a locked chest and the skill book The Buying Game (+1 Speech).
tips: The ambush appears if you go there right after Helgen

items.title: The Miner's Lament
items.location: Solstheim, directly west of Brodir Grove
items.description: A miner was crushed by his own ore wagon. Under it are rocks and four pieces of gold ore. A crate by the tent holds a strongbox, an emerald and Nord mead, and emerald geodes and a gold ore vein are nearby.

items.title: Troll Den: Rkund
items.location: The Rift, west of the Ruins of Rkund and Darklight Tower, south of Largashbur (visible from the top of Darklight Tower)
items.description: A hidden ruined barrow where a troll lives. Inside are a locked chest, a burial urn, remains and a helmet hidden in a hole in the wall. The helmet is random and leveled.
tips: A little to the east, by a fallen birch, lies the book Proper Lock Design

items.title: Angarvunde Hidden Stash
items.location: Angarvunde, The Rift: from Medresi's camp at the entrance, climb the slope to the south-southeast
items.description: Higher up the mountain above Medresi's camp is a small hidden spot with a strongbox, lockpicks and potions. The strongbox may hold gems and gold.
tips: The strongbox is locked; take the lockpicks right there

items.title: Skaal Village Hidden Remains
items.location: Solstheim, the slope below Skaal Village: go down and turn left behind a lone spruce
items.description: The spruce hides a small, sad scene: a treasure hunter died fighting a large beast, and next to him lie his sword and a chest with random loot. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Two Lost Crates
items.location: Falkreath Hold, a high cliff south of Angi's Camp; reachable only by a faint path from the road
items.description: Two abandoned crates sit on a hard-to-reach cliff above Angi's Camp. Under them is the Sneak skill book Three Thieves.
tips: You can't climb up from Angi's Camp below: look for a path into the mountains from the road

items.title: The Poultry Reanimator
items.location: The Rift, south of Lake Geir, southeast of Ivarstead
items.description: A novice necromancer prays at a strange egg "altar" and raises dead chickens that rush into battle. A crate by the altar holds a giant's toe, a soul gem and chicken eggs.
tips: The necromancer carries the Conjuration skill book 2920, Frostfall, v10

items.title: Spider Nest (Kagrumez)
items.location: Solstheim, west-southwest of Kagrumez
items.description: Egg sacs hang on a broken stump with a burning log; a jumping flame spider bursts out of the big one. Nearby are a knapsack, an apothecary's satchel and a ruby geode.

items.title: Pincushion Peter
items.location: Haafingar, east of the Thalmor Embassy, above the sabre cat lair, on a steep snowy slope
items.description: A skeleton pinned to the slope by five kinds of weapons (some leveled). Nearby are a Light Armor skill book, a knapsack and a Staff of Fireballs you can get even at level 1.
tips: Staff of Fireballs: a 40-damage area explosion
The weapons in the skeleton don't respawn

items.title: Sunken Treasures
items.location: Wreck of the Brinehammer, northwest of Dawnstar; underwater north-northwest of the ship
items.description: Underwater by the sunken ship is a locked chest that always holds the Alteration skill book Sithis and leveled loot.
tips: Bring lockpicks: the lock is hard
Another (apprentice) chest lies underwater by the stern

items.title: Chest upriver from Dragon Bridge
items.en: Сундук в реке у Драконьего моста
items.location: Dragon Bridge, upriver, under a fallen tree
items.description: Swim upriver from Dragon Bridge: under a fallen tree is a chest (apprentice lock) with leveled loot. The author found a Staff of Fury, lockpicks and gems there. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Brush Strongbox: Riverside
items.en: Ящик в коряге у реки Карт
items.location: The Reach, southeast of Karthwasten, on the southeast bank of the Karth River, in a pile of driftwood
items.description: A locked strongbox is hidden in a pile of driftwood on the bank, with a leveled dagger leaning against it; at high levels it can be Daedric. A nirnroot grows nearby.

items.title: Pride of Tel Vos Island Cache
items.en: Тайник на островке у «Гордости Тель Воса»
items.location: An islet southeast of the Wreck of the Pride of Tel Vos (east of Winterhold)
items.description: On an islet with bears, under the south end of a log, are the Heavy Armor skill book Chimarvamidium and leveled enchanted armor. At high levels it can be ebony.

items.title: Island Chest at Lost Valley Redoubt
items.location: Lost Valley Redoubt, a small lake by the path below Bard's Leap Summit
items.description: On the way up to Bard's Leap Summit, look down: the small lake has an islet with a hidden chest of random loot and a silver ore vein nearby.

items.title: Western Watchtower Hidden Chest
items.en: Тайный сундук у Западной сторожевой башни
items.location: Western Watchtower west of Whiterun, under the platform by the wall
items.description: Besides the guarded guard chest (looting it counts as theft), another chest is hidden near the tower that you can take freely: jump down from the platform by the wall and look around. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Hillgrund's Tomb Stash
items.location: Hillgrund's Tomb, the boulders above the entrance
items.description: Climb the rocks above the tomb entrance to find a small stash: about 48 gold and a mid-level chest. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Labyrinthian Drowned Skeleton
items.location: Labyrinthian, the cave with the tower: a pool near malachite and gold ore
items.description: A skeleton pinned by rocks lies underwater, and in front of it is a gold diamond ring: it seems the poor soul dived for the ring. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Avanchnzel Mountain Path
items.location: Avanchnzel (northeast of Riften), the climb into the mountains from the upper platform
items.description: From the platform by the ruins a path leads into the mountains; at the top, by some crates, are random light gauntlets (Dragonscale from level 46) and a Light Armor skill book. (from the video, unverified)
tips: The gauntlets are random loot: save first

items.title: Forsworn Ambush Camp
items.location: The valley south of Volskygge, near Mor Khazgur
items.description: A dead Nord lies among three bear traps, and two Forsworn wait in ambush nearby. Their shelter is hidden among the rocks: a small chest, a poison recipe, traps and a bedroll.

items.title: Ruined Barrow with Shrine of Talos
items.location: Central Skyrim, near Gallows Rock, by a small pond past a lone stone arch
items.description: A lone stone arch and a Nord head nearby mark the ruins of an ancient barrow. The main entrance is blocked, but there is a Shrine of Talos, a chest with random loot and a Heavy Armor skill book. (from the video, unverified)
tips: A Spriggan Earth Mother roams nearby

items.title: Waterfall Chest near Orotheim
items.location: West of Orotheim, under the second waterfall on the river
items.description: A skeleton lies next to a locked chest (Novice lock). Inside are a few gems.

items.title: Two Pine Ridge
items.location: Northeast of Stendarr's Beacon, the Rift
items.description: Under two pines at the top of the ridge is a small miner's camp. By the bedroll lie a pickaxe and two books: Cats of Skyrim and 2920, Last Seed, v8, which raises Sneak.

items.title: Boneyard Rooftop Chests
items.location: Soul Cairn, the Boneyard: the arena of the Durnehviir fight (Dawnguard)
items.description: On top of the building by Durnehviir's arena stands a large chest that no teleport well leads to: you reach it by jumping along ledges. A second chest on a far overhang takes Whirlwind Sprint; the author got a Dragonbone sword from it. (from the video, unverified)
tips: Save before jumping: the climb is very awkward
The loot in the chests is random

items.title: The Lost Library
items.location: Hob's Fall Cave west of Winterhold: the ancient tome chest in the reading room
items.description: In the Anniversary Edition (Arcane Accessories Creation) there is a chest here with all 16 new spell tomes, including Unbounded Storms. You can come here even at level 1.
tips: According to the video, if you hold a cloak spell and fast travel far, Destruction rises sharply (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Emberbrand Wine
items.location: Raven Rock, a stash between the foundations of ruined houses southwest of an abandoned building (quest Recipe for Distraction)
items.description: Captain Veleth asks you to find where his guards hide their wine. Emberbrand Wine restores 60 Stamina and slows the target's Stamina regeneration by 60% for 120 seconds. The game has only 8 bottles, all from this stash.
tips: The barrel appears only after the quest starts
The author sees the quest as a nod to the prohibition at Fort Frostmoth in Bloodmoon (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Best Nightingale Gear
items.location: Thieves Guild: the Twilight Sepulcher (Trinity Restored)
items.description: Nightingale Armor reaches its best version if you start Trinity Restored at level 32 or higher. Nightingale Blade and Bow: from level 46.
tips: The armor level is locked when the quest starts, not when you receive it

items.title: Froki's Shack Diamond and Diadem of the Savant
items.en: Алмаз и диадема у хижины Фроки
items.location: The Rift, Froki's Shack: the chopping block and the rock below the shack
items.description: A real diamond sticks out of the orichalcum ore vein below the shack, with a pickaxe nearby. The Diadem of the Savant lies on the chopping block, though it was meant as the reward for Shalidor's Maze.
tips: You can take the diamond and diadem even at level 1
Without the Unofficial Patch the diadem respawns; with it, a leveled item appears instead

items.title: Bloated Man's Grotto Hidden Chest
items.location: Bloated Man's Grotto (Falkreath Hold, north of Falkreath): the clearing with the dead deer, the ridge on the east side
items.description: Besides the two chests in plain sight, the grotto has a third. Climb the rocky rim where it is lowest, east of the clearing with the dead deer: a large Master-locked chest is hidden between two tall rocks.
tips: The spot is easy to recognize: wolves are eating a deer and a spriggan attacks

items.title: Keeping the Rusty Mace
items.location: The abandoned house in Markarth; a weapon rack in any of your homes
items.description: The Rusty Mace, a quest item from The House of Horrors, can't be dropped, but it can be hung on a weapon rack. You don't have to kill Logrolf with it, and you still get the Mace of Molag Bal at the end. This way you keep both the rusty mace and the real one.

items.title: Steel Battleaxe of Fiery Souls
items.location: Ironbind Barrow, Winterhold Hold: by Warlord Gathrik's throne
items.description: The only weapon with the Fiery Soul Trap enchantment, which combines soul trap and fire damage in one effect. Disenchant it at an arcane enchanter and you can put the double effect on your own weapon, for example a silver one.
tips: The effect strength depends on Conjuration, not Destruction

items.title: Potions of Waterwalking
items.location: Raven Rock Mine (Bloodskal Barrow dungeon), Solstheim
items.description: The four Potions of Waterwalking in this mine are the only ones in the game. Merchants don't sell them and you can't brew them.
tips: Don't drink them right away: there is nowhere else to get them

items.title: Blackguard's Armor at Level 1
items.location: Raven Rock, Solstheim: the basement of Glover Mallory's house, behind a locked door
items.description: A full set of Blackguard's light thief armor (the armor gives +50 carry weight, the hood gives better prices, the gloves make lockpicking easier, the boots help with pickpocketing). Glover usually gives you the key after Paid in Full. According to the video, you can get through the door earlier: at 8 PM Glover goes to the Retching Netch, pick the lock of his house (Adept), put a wooden plate by the basement door and slam into it with Whirlwind Sprint.
tips: Save before the sprint: it almost never works the first time
Get back out the same way, using a basket

items.title: Telekinesis at Level 1
items.location: Redwater Den, the Rift: a prison cell by the vats, next to a novice conjurer's corpse
items.description: One of the few guaranteed Spell Tome: Telekinesis copies in the game, and you can take it even at level 1. The cell is easiest to reach by drinking the local Redwater Skooma and being taken there by the story, but you can also just get there yourself.

items.title: Holdings of Jarl Gjalund
items.location: Dragonsreach, Farengar's desk, after the quest Bleak Falls Barrow
items.description: The only copy of an ancient document of the Jarls of Whiterun, studied by Farengar and Delphine. The line about an oath to the "old and new" gods is, in the video author's view, a nod to A Song of Ice and Fire.
tips: The book appears on the desk after the scene with Delphine

items.title: Bow of the Hunt
items.location: Clearspring Cave under Clearspring Tarn, Eastmarch (west of Shor's Stone)
items.description: A unique hunting bow on an altar in a small cave: +20 damage to animals (including insects and trolls). Available from level 1, with an Archery skill book nearby.
tips: The tarn itself has a chest with an apprentice lock

items.title: Yellow Mountain Flower
items.location: Ancestor Glade (Dawnguard), Falkreath Hold
items.description: Almost the only place with Yellow Mountain Flowers. It gives Fortify Restoration, and with salt it makes a simple potion recipe for the Restoration loop.

items.title: Summon Arniel's Shade
items.location: College of Winterhold, reward for the quest Arniel's Endeavor
items.description: The spell costs no Magicka and summons Arniel Gane's shade for 60 seconds; the shade is invulnerable. You can keep using it to distract a strong boss (for example, the Ebony Warrior) while you attack from range.
tips: The vampire Necromage perk and a Fortify Conjuration potion noticeably extend the summon

items.title: Hrodulf's House Secrets
items.location: Hrodulf's House, Solstheim (Dragonborn)
items.description: On the east part of the roof is a locked chest with gold; you can jump up via a log. The secret basement holds a unique lit torch: it weighs nothing and, unlike normal torches, casts dynamic shadows.

items.title: Brittleshin Pass Garnet Eyes
items.location: Brittleshin Pass, the large hall right past the south entrance
items.description: High on the wall is a carved stone Nord face with two flawless garnets in its eye sockets. Knock them down with an arrow or the Flames spell.
tips: Check the eyes of statues and faces: gems are often hidden there

items.title: Removing the Stolen Tag
items.location: Anywhere
items.description: The "Stolen" tag never goes away by itself. You can clear it by selling the item to a fence and buying it back, or by passing it through a follower.
tips: Put the items in an unowned container, tell your follower to take everything, then take it back through trade
You can put an item in the cupboard behind the counter of the Riverwood Trader and buy it from Lucan
Items fully used up in crafting (ingredients, food, pelts) do not pass the tag on to the result
Method from the video: befriend a house owner, put their stolen item into any container in the same house and take it again (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Falmer Are Blind
items.location: Dwarven ruins and Falmer caves
items.description: All Falmer are blind, but their hearing is excellent. You can pickpocket a Falmer right in front of them, but your footsteps make sneaking past them hard.
tips: Silent footsteps (the Muffle spell or enchantment) let you get right up close
High Sneak with the Muffled Movement perk also works

items.title: Become Ethereal Fall Trick
items.location: Any high cliff; the Become Ethereal shout
items.description: While ethereal you take no damage at all, including falling damage. Use Become Ethereal before you jump, and you can leap off a mountaintop and land unharmed.
tips: Shout BEFORE the jump: it does not work in mid-air
The more words of the shout you know, the longer it lasts, so time your fall

items.title: The Steed Stone
items.location: The Steed Stone, west of Solitude, north of Wolfskull Cave
items.description: The Steed Stone gives more than +100 carry weight: equipped armor weighs nothing, so even heavy armor does not slow your movement or attacks.
tips: Ideal for heavy armor and for sneaking in it: no speed penalty

items.title: Arkngthamz Hidden Loot
items.location: Arkngthamz ("Lost to the Ages", Dawnguard)
items.description: The ruin hides several stashes: a flooded underwater tunnel leads to a hidden round room with a chest and coin purses, a Falmer chest stands behind a waterfall, and a Dwarven chest hides behind a slanted arch near a brass pipe.
tips: Tonal lock resonator order: bottom left, bottom right, top left, top right, bottom middle
A note with a hint for the lock lies next to a dead adventurer

items.title: Vigilants Cure Diseases
items.location: Any Vigilant of Stendarr on the roads or in the Hall of the Vigilant
items.description: If you are sick, a Vigilant of Stendarr will cure any disease. You only have to promise never to serve the Daedra.
tips: The Vigilant must not be in combat
This does not cure lycanthropy or vampirism

items.title: Skipping First Lessons
items.location: College of Winterhold, Hall of the Elements
items.description: If one of the three apprentices dies, Tolfdir cancels the ward lesson and goes straight to the next quest, "Under Saarthal". He has a special line for this.
tips: Killing an apprentice gives you a bounty, which you will have to pay

items.title: Sell Items One at a Time
items.location: Any merchant
items.description: Selling a stack of identical items at once gives Speech experience as if you sold just one. Sell them one by one for many times more experience.
tips: No need to leave the barter menu between sales, just sell one at a time
The more valuable the item, the more experience

items.title: Glacial Crevice Underwater Passage
items.location: Glacial Crevice, Forgotten Vale ("Touching the Sky")
items.description: In the first large cavern, skip the main path and dive into the water: an underwater passage west of the iceberg leads straight through, past many Falmer. Along the way are Falmer bodies and hidden chests.
tips: Waterbreathing potions or enchantments help
Handy for a stealth run

items.title: Double Dwarven Chests
items.location: Fahlbtharz, Solstheim (Dragonborn), the alcove under the steam puzzle platform
items.description: Some Dwarven chests are placed twice in the same spot, so you can search them twice in a row with different loot. It is a placement error; the Unofficial Patch fixes it.
tips: After emptying the chest, activate it again

items.title: Blackreach in Daylight
items.location: Blackreach, exit to Mzinchaleft Gatehouse
items.description: If you leave Blackreach into Mzinchaleft Gatehouse and come right back, the cavern may become lit with normal daylight. This makes it much easier to find Crimson Nirnroot and find your way.
tips: Only works if it is daytime outside
A known bug; it still happens in the Legendary Edition

items.title: Bandits and Dropped Armor
items.location: Bandit camps, while sneaking
items.description: Sneak up on a bandit unseen and drop a piece of armor they do not have: some bandits walk over, politely ask if they may take it, and do not attack. Drop armor between two bandits and they may fight over it. (from the video, unverified)
tips: Does not work on every bandit
While the bandit goes for the item, you can hide again

items.title: Dragon Riding Autopilot
items.location: Anywhere; requires the Bend Will shout (Dragonborn)
items.description: Mount a dragon and wait for the autosave on takeoff, then fast travel to the place you want and load that autosave. The dragon will fly on its own to the spot you traveled to. (from the video, unverified)
tips: Autosave must be enabled in the settings

items.title: Bow Bash After a Shot
items.location: Bow combat at point-blank range
items.description: A bow bash normally does almost no damage and only interrupts power attacks. According to the video, if you bash right after a shot at point-blank range, it deals the damage of the shot. Works with any bow. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Cancelling a Shout
items.location: Anywhere
items.description: If you start a shout and change your mind, draw or sheathe your weapon (R by default) and the shout is cut off before it is released. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Wolves Ignore Werewolves
items.location: The wilds; werewolf form
items.description: In werewolf form, wolves do not attack you, though spiders and other animals do. Almost all townsfolk and travelers will attack you.
tips: With Howl of Terror, wolves may even help you fight

items.title: Homestead Coffin
items.location: Your homestead (Hearthfire), the alcove by the basement stairs
items.description: A vampire can place a coffin in the basement alcove. According to the video, sleeping in it gives the Vampiric Blood Rested bonus to Magic Resistance, on top of Lover's Comfort and the parent bonus. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Five Magic Books in The Hidden Twilight
items.location: Apocrypha, Black Book: The Hidden Twilight (Tel Mithryn, Solstheim), Chapters IV and V
items.description: The only room in Chapter IV is guarded by a Seeker. Its scrivener opens a gate in Chapter V, and behind it five skill books lie on a table, one for each school of magic. Many players go straight to Chapter VI and miss this stash.
tips: Go to Chapter IV first and activate the scrivener there, then go to Chapter V
Take the Scholar's Insight power in Black Book: The Winds of Change (Raven Rock Mine) beforehand: with it, every skill book gives two skill increases

items.title: Thieves Guild Cache in Whiterun
items.location: Whiterun, behind Ysolda's house near the main gate, behind the woodpile
items.description: A small chest is marked with the Thieves Guild "Cache" shadowmark. It holds coins and various small items. The contents respawn.
tips: Look for these marks on walls in every city: they point to caches and useful places

items.title: Soul Husk
items.location: Soul Cairn (Dawnguard), grows all over the Cairn
items.description: Soul Husks are edible and protect you from the health drain of the Ideal Masters' crystals. You can trade them: 25 to the merchant in the Soul Cairn for leveled gear, or 5 to Valerica for Soul Husk Extract.
tips: Eat a husk before searching a chest under an Ideal Masters' crystal

items.title: Permanent Light in the Severin Manor Basement
items.en: Вечный свет в подвале поместья Северин
items.location: Raven Rock, Severin Manor (reward for "Served Cold"), basement
items.description: The basement is dark, but you can drop several torches on the floor and place the lit ones where you want. After waiting a day or two, they stay lit permanently, like normal light sources (from the video, unverified).
tips: Spouses, stewards and children cannot live in Severin Manor

items.title: Netch Jelly Dragon Dismount
items.en: Десант с дракона на желе нетча
items.location: Anywhere; requires the Bend Will shout (Dragonborn) and Netch Jelly
items.description: If you eat Netch Jelly while riding a dragon under Bend Will, the paralysis knocks you off the dragon right above your target. This way you can reach the mushroom roofs of Tel Mithryn or the top of the tower at Ilinalta's Deep and grab the Black Star without clearing the dungeon. The author says this does not break the quest. (from the video, unverified)
tips: Put Netch Jelly on a hotkey to eat it exactly above the target
Save before jumping: you may miss

items.title: Faster Sneaking with a Weapon Drawn
items.location: Anywhere
items.description: When sneaking with a weapon drawn, you move noticeably faster than with empty hands. (from the video, unverified)
tips: Put a weapon on a hotkey to draw it quickly while sneaking

items.title: Spider Scrolls
items.location: White Ridge Barrow, Solstheim, the Imbuing Chamber in the White Ridge Sanctum
items.description: The Dwarven Imbuing Chamber combines an Albino Spider Pod and a gem into "spider scrolls": jumping exploding spiders, spiders wrapped in fire or frost, and mind-controlling spiders. A normal gem gives three spiders, a flawless one gives six. According to the video, if you release them in a town, people do not blame you.
tips: Notes with recipes lie near the device; other combinations can be found by experimenting

items.title: Three Stones with the Aetherial Crown
items.location: Any three standing stones; requires the Aetherial Crown
items.description: The crown keeps your previous stone blessing on top of the current one. The video author took off the crown, took a new blessing from a stone and put the crown back on, and ended up with three blessings at once: the Atronach, the Steed and the Lord. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Enchanting Silver Weapons
items.location: Gallows Rock, Eastmarch: the Silver Hand often carry silver swords, both one-handed and two-handed
items.description: Silver weapons deal +20 damage to undead and werewolves, and this property cannot be removed. They cannot be improved at a grindstone, but they can be enchanted on top of the silver. After that the description shows only the new enchantment, but the bonus against undead remains.
tips: With the Extra Effect perk, two enchantments fit on top of a silver weapon

items.title: Fortify Restoration Loop
items.location: Any alchemy lab; requires gear with Fortify Alchemy
items.description: Fortify Restoration potions also boost the enchantments on your gear. Drink one, take off and re-equip your Alchemy gear and brew a new potion: it comes out stronger, and so on in a loop up to huge values. Then brew super-strong Fortify Enchanting potions (Hagraven Claw + Snowberries) and craft weapons with thousands of damage.
tips: Ingredients: Abecean Longfin, Small Pearl, Small Antlers, Cyrodilic Spadetail, Salt Pile
This is a game-breaking exploit; the Unofficial Patch fixes it

items.title: Training on Katria
items.location: Arkngthamz (Dawnguard), start of the dungeon
items.description: Katria cannot die: when you hit her, she drops to one knee and asks "Feel better?" as she gets up. While she fights back, you can train weapon, magic and armor skills. The author says that if she disappears, she comes back after you wait an hour. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Frenzy on a Wispmother
items.location: Any Wispmother (usually in forests and near ruins)
items.description: Cast a Frenzy spell from a high-level Illusion school on a Wispmother and she stops attacking you: only her wisps fight. When attacked, she keeps spawning more shade copies. (from the video, unverified)
tips: A Wispmother can create endless shades; if you kill the wisps first, there will be no copies

items.title: Follower Fills All Soul Gems
items.location: Any follower
items.description: Give your follower empty soul gems and a weapon with Soul Trap. A single kill fills every empty gem of a suitable size in their inventory, not just one.
tips: For example, 60+ grand soul gems are filled by one dead giant or troll
Then take the filled gems back through trade

items.title: Dragonskin + Atronach Stone
items.location: Breton, the Atronach Stone
items.description: The Breton power Dragonskin absorbs 50% of the magicka from enemy spells for 60 seconds, and the Atronach Stone adds another 50%. Together that is 100% absorption: mages deal no damage and only refill your magicka.
tips: Unlike Magic Resistance, absorption is not capped at 80%
Dragonskin does not absorb spells reflected by a ward

items.title: Immortal Legate as a Training Dummy
items.location: Whiterun Hold, due north of Gjukar's Monument, the site of the future Imperial camp
items.description: From the start of the game, Legate Quentin Cipius stands alone in the wasteland. He is essential: after dropping to one knee he gets up and keeps fighting, so you can train One-Handed, Sneak and Destruction on him.
tips: Wait an hour so he calms down and forgets the fight

items.title: Riekling Follower with a Giant's Club
items.location: Thirsk Mead Hall, Solstheim; any giant camp
items.description: After "The Chief of Thirsk Hall" you can take rieklings as followers, and they do not take your main follower slot. Give a riekling a giant's club (you cannot pick it up yourself) and it will fight with it like a two-handed weapon. (from the video, unverified)
tips: If the rieklings will not follow you after the chief is killed, dismiss your main follower and hire them again

items.title: The Strongest Werewolf Hit
items.location: Frostmoon Crag, Solstheim, from Majni
items.description: The Ring of Bloodlust (sold to werewolves at Frostmoon Crag) gives +50% damage in beast form, but you also take +50% damage. Combined with the Orc Berserker Rage the damage is huge; the Lord Stone offsets the weakness.
tips: Activate Berserker Rage first, then transform

items.title: Steal a Briar Heart
items.location: Any Forsworn Briarheart (Forsworn forts in the Reach)
items.description: If you pickpocket the Briar Heart from a Forsworn Briarheart unseen, he dies instantly. You cannot put the heart back to revive him.
tips: Requires high Sneak and Pickpocket

items.title: Magicka Refill by Swapping Gear
items.location: Anywhere
items.description: When your magicka runs out, take off your Fortify Magicka gear and put it back on: your current magicka instantly rises by its bonus. It helps to put the items on hotkeys. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Gems from Ore Veins
items.location: Any ore vein
items.description: Each piece of ore you mine has a 10% chance to give a random level-based gem as well. Even an ordinary iron vein can drop a diamond.
tips: Save before the vein and reload if no gem drops

items.title: Pedestal Pressure Plate Trick
items.location: Nordic barrows: pedestals with a pressure plate
items.description: Items on barrow pedestals often sit on a pressure plate, and taking them sets off a trap. Drop any small item (a petty soul gem, a gem) on the plate, then take both the prize and your item: the trap will not fire. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Hot Spring Hunters Guard Their Clothes
items.location: Eastmarch hot springs where hunters bathe
items.description: Usually you can pick up someone else's item by holding E and carry it off without anyone noticing. But if you grab the clothes of hunters bathing in the springs this way, they attack at once. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Aetherial Crown Power Reset
items.en: Этериевая корона и камни без перезарядки
items.location: Reward for "Lost to the Ages" (Dawnguard)
items.description: If the Aetherial Crown stores a stone with a once-a-day power (Tower, Serpent, Ritual, Shadow), you can use the power again just by taking off the crown and putting it back on. For example, the Shadow Stone gives endless invisibility.
tips: Put the crown and the power on hotkeys

items.title: Ritual Stone Army
items.location: The Ritual Stone, east of Whiterun by the road
items.description: The Ritual Stone power has no limit on how many corpses it raises, and they do not crumble to ash when the effect ends. You can lead the raised dead to new bodies and build a huge army. The Necromage perk raises the corpse level limit above 75.
tips: With the Aetherial Crown you can use the power again right away

items.title: Malkoran's Second Shade
items.location: Kilkreath Temple (Kilkreath Ruins), "The Break of Dawn"
items.description: If you raise Malkoran's corpse and it gets killed again, a second Malkoran's Shade appears, and it drops another 250 gold. The shades are hostile to everyone, including you.

items.title: Agnis, Servant of the Fort
items.location: Fort Greymoor, dining hall and kitchen
items.description: This harmless old woman serves whoever holds the fort: bandits, the Legion or the Stormcloaks. She says she is not leaving: "I come with the place!" Her little room is full of other people's shoes.
tips: She is not hostile when you clear the fort
You can kill her for the Dark Brotherhood: "Kill Agnis"
A possible nod to Madam Rosmerta and the Three Broomsticks: there are three brooms on the table in her room (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Frea as a Follower
items.location: Skaal Village, Solstheim (Dragonborn)
items.description: The daughter of the shaman Storn becomes a follower after "The Fate of the Skaal". She has unique lines and can talk to other characters.
tips: She wears heavy armor though she is a light armor specialist: change her armor
Take her along on "The Path of Knowledge": she comments on Nchardak and talks with Neloth

items.title: Frodnar and Stump
items.location: Riverwood
items.description: Stump is the dog of Frodnar, a boy from Riverwood. If Frodnar's parents die and you adopt him, Stump keeps following him: every day he runs from Riverwood to your house and back.

items.title: Vittoria Vici's Groom
items.location: Solitude, Vittoria's wedding ("Bound Until Death")
items.description: Asgeir Snow-Shod is marrying the Emperor's cousin, yet he flirts with any female Dragonborn: "Should my new bride be worried?" Vittoria, for her part, shares a bed with a certain Aquillius Aeresius.
tips: Play a female character to hear Asgeir's line; to a man he says not to get too close to his bride

items.title: Serana Joins In
items.location: Anywhere with idle markers: forges, bathing spots, altars, shops
items.description: While you stand still, Serana uses free idle markers more readily than other followers: she sharpens her sword at a grindstone, works on armor at a workbench, plays the lute, leans on a fence, sits in a hot spring or "performs a ritual" with a dagger. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Logrolf's Secret
items.location: Dragon Bridge, Azzada Lylvieve's house; Markarth, the abandoned house
items.description: The farmer Azzada Lylvieve says he grew up an orphan in Markarth and survived thanks to an old warrior, Logrolf. In the evening he discusses a letter from Logrolf with his wife; Logrolf sleeps on the street because his house is haunted. This is the same Logrolf the Willful from "The House of Horrors".
tips: Sell Azzada cabbages to become his friend and be allowed to sleep in his house
You can overhear the talk with his wife in the evening, when the family is home

items.title: Neloth and the Arch-Mage
items.location: Tel Mithryn, Solstheim (Dragonborn)
items.description: If you are already Arch-Mage of the College, you can tell Neloth that archmages should share their secrets. He calls Winterhold a small college "falling into the Sea of Ghosts", praises you for recovering the Staff of Magnus and promises to teach you "a trick or two" once his apprentice Talvas finishes "in a couple of decades".

items.title: An Afflicted Sister's Doubts
items.location: Bthardamz (the Reach), Bthardamz Dwelling, entered from the Upper District
items.description: If you sneak into the Dwelling unseen, you can overhear an afflicted sister talking to her sleeping brother: she does not feel Peryite's favor, misses the Reach and curses the day she introduced her brother to Orchendor. Many players walk past this side area.
tips: Enter while sneaking, or the scene turns into a fight
Next to them is an unlocked chest; behind a gate is the skill book "Biography of the Wolf Queen"

items.title: Inkpot, Stone, Bucket
items.location: Riften, the Ratway Warrens, a locked dark room
items.description: Mad Hefid the Deaf endlessly repeats a list: "Inkpot. Stone. Bucket. Book. Knife." She really has all of them: an inkwell, a flawless garnet, a bucket, a burned book and an iron dagger. The video author thinks it is an Atronach Forge recipe, but that is only his guess.
tips: If you take her inkwell, her lines change

items.title: Maro, Not Maron
items.location: Solitude, Penitus Oculatus commander (Dark Brotherhood quests)
items.description: In the original he is called Commander Maro; the Russian localization added an "n" at the end. In Morrowind, Oritius Maro serves in the Gnisis Barracks: a member of the Talos Cult plotting against the Emperor, while today's Maro guards the Emperor. A family link is not confirmed.

items.title: Courage for Followers
items.location: Any follower; the Illusion spell Courage
items.description: Cast Courage on a follower and many reply with a unique line: Stenvar says he could "crush a giant's head like a walnut", and a mead lover insists "that ain't just the mead talkin'". (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Gerdur Before Ralof
items.location: Riverwood, the lumber mill, Gerdur
items.description: If you escape with Ralof, then run ahead and talk to Gerdur first, you get separate dialogue: at first she does not trust a stranger. If you arrive together with Ralof, the conversation goes differently.

items.title: Shadowscales of Legend
items.location: Argonians in towns, with high Sneak
items.description: If you sneak up on an Argonian with high Sneak, he may say: "You remind me of the Shadowscales, from the old histories." The Shadowscales are the Argonian assassins of the Dark Brotherhood. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Who Put a Contract on Anoriath?
items.location: Whiterun, the market, Anoriath's stall
items.description: Olfina Gray-Mane buys sausages "for a friend", and when Anoriath hints that he has seen her with him, she threatens him: gossip is bad for your health. Soon Nazir offers a contract on Anoriath, so she may well be the client.
tips: This is a hint, not a fact: the game never names the client

items.title: Don't Litter
items.location: Towns and settlements
items.description: If you drop cheap junk like tankards and bottles near townsfolk, they complain, and there are many lines, from "There's a place for trash, and that's not it" to "uncouth savages". (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Braith's Crush
items.location: Whiterun, Wind District, near the House of Clan Battle-Born
items.description: Braith bullies Lars Battle-Born and demands money from him. If Lars asks for help and you talk to Braith, she admits she does not mean it and would stop kicking him if he kissed her.

items.title: Warmaiden's Alternate Dialogue
items.location: Whiterun, Warmaiden's: Adrianne Avenicci and Ulfberth War-Bear
items.description: If Eorlund Gray-Mane dies, Adrianne says he was the best smith, "but now he's dead". If Adrianne herself dies, Ulfberth starts buying weapons from the Khajiit caravans. If the Stormcloaks rule Whiterun, Adrianne complains about fewer customers: the Stormcloaks only buy from Nords.
tips: Eorlund stops being essential only after the Companions quests

items.title: Lleril Morvayn's Mother
items.location: Raven Rock, Morvayn Manor, the "History of Raven Rock" books by the throne
items.description: Lleril Morvayn took over from his mother, Mistress Brara Morvayn. She founded Raven Rock with House Redoran, and in Morrowind you can talk to her in Ald'ruhn. Lleril's father is unknown: Brara's first husband, Remas Morvayn, died long before the move to Solstheim.
tips: Read "History of Raven Rock": it tells how the town was founded

items.title: Where Deposed Jarls Go
items.location: Solitude, Blue Palace basement (Stormcloak victory) or Windhelm, Palace of the Kings (Imperial victory)
items.description: Jarls deposed in the civil war do not vanish. If the Stormcloaks win, Imperial supporters other than Elisif live in the Blue Palace basement; if the Legion wins, Ulfric's supporters move to the Palace of the Kings in Windhelm. The exiles have their own lines: for example, Laila Law-Giver mourns the loss of the Rift.
tips: Visit them after the final civil war battle: Idgrod Ravencrone, the former Jarl of Morthal, is noticeably more cheerful in exile than the others

items.title: The Eighth Form of Silence
items.location: Tel Mithryn, Solstheim (Dragonborn): ask Neloth if you can help with his research
items.description: One of Neloth's rare small tasks: he has found "an eighth" form of silence and asks to test it on you. The spell blinds you, tentacles grow out of your eyes, and Talvas barely keeps from vomiting. The effect wears off quickly, and Neloth pays you for your time.
tips: Neloth's tasks are random: ask him about his research several times

items.title: Voice of the Emperor in Helgen
items.location: Helgen Keep, escaping with Ralof; play as an Imperial
items.description: If you escape with Ralof and use the Imperial racial power Voice of the Emperor on Imperial soldiers, they calm down and say rare lines: they mention a comrade carried off by the dragon and recognize you from the rebels' cart. (from the video, unverified)

items.title: Ralof and Hadvar's Fate
items.location: Civil war, the first quests of both sides
items.description: Whoever you escape Helgen with later fights beside you in the civil war if you join his faction. If you escape with Ralof but join the Legion, Ralof disappears from the game entirely. The same goes for Hadvar if you escape with him and join the Stormcloaks.
tips: To meet both, escape Helgen with the one whose side you plan to join

items.title: Falas Selvayn, the Night Trader
items.location: Ramshackle Trading Post, Solstheim, only from midnight to 4 a.m.
items.description: The trader shows up in the ruined trading post only at night; if you arrive earlier and wait there, he will not come. He sells ingredients, arrows and even Daedra Hearts. According to the video, he can carry an Ebony Bow as early as level 1, and you can steal it by paralyzing him with the Serpent Stone power (the stone is on the cliffs above Winterhold).
tips: His unique Glass Bow of the Stag Prince can only be stolen, and that requires the Misdirection perk

items.title: Talking to the Champion of Boethiah
items.location: "Boethiah's Calling", the former Champion of Boethiah's lair
items.description: Boethiah's former champion attacks on sight, but if you calm him (Pacify, the Imperial Voice of the Emperor, or the Bend Will shout), you unlock unique dialogue: he refused to serve Boethiah and now forges armor. You still have to kill him: after calming wears off, he turns hostile again.
tips: Sheathe your weapon and use the calm effect before he notices you

items.title: Alvor's Alternate Greetings
items.location: Riverwood, Alvor's forge (after escaping with Hadvar)
items.description: If you run ahead of Hadvar, talk to Alvor first and say Hadvar sent you, you tell him about the dragon at Helgen yourself. If you wait for Hadvar, the meeting between uncle and nephew plays out differently.
tips: Run ahead as soon as you enter Riverwood to see the first version

items.title: Paarthurnax Remembers Your Answer on Destiny
items.location: Throat of the World, Paarthurnax
items.description: When Paarthurnax asks why you want to stop Alduin, choose "I don't believe in destiny, but I will stop Alduin." After defeating Alduin, tell him you were fulfilling your destiny, and he will remind you that you did not believe in it.

items.title: Delphine Away from the Inn
items.location: Riverwood, Sleeping Giant Inn; Dragonsreach, Whiterun
items.description: Until the Dragonstone is handed to Farengar, Delphine is not at the inn: Orgnar says she is the owner and comes and goes as she pleases, and he will not rent you her room. When you return to Farengar, you find her talking with him about dragons.
tips: If you bring the Dragonstone without taking Farengar's task, the scene with Delphine will not happen

items.title: Bashnag, a Rare Orc Mage
items.location: Southfringe Sanctum, Falkreath Hold (at the end of the dungeon, by the enchanter)
items.description: Apart from Urag gro-Shub, Bashnag is almost the only Orc mage in Skyrim. He wears ancient Nord armor and always carries the Destruction skill book "The Art of War Magic". His ancestor is Yargol gro-Bashnag from Morrowind, a worshipper of Malacath near the Zergonipal ruins.

items.title: Ulfric Waits for the Wedding
items.location: Windhelm, Ulfric; Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, Astrid
items.description: If you reach "Battle for Solitude" on the Stormcloak side while Vittoria Vici is still alive, Ulfric delays the assault: the Emperor's cousin is getting married, and spilling royal blood would drag the whole Empire into the war. If you start the siege first, Astrid has a special line about ruined plans in "Bound Until Death" (from the video, unverified).

items.title: Punishment in the Temple of Dibella
items.location: Markarth, Temple of Dibella, inner sanctum
items.description: Hamal sets a different punishment for a character caught in the sanctum: men get "a quick death", women "a period of servitude". In both cases you are offered the chance to find the new Sybil instead.

items.title: Fjotra's Farewell
items.location: Karthwasten, Enmon and Mena
items.description: You can take the rescued Fjotra to Karthwasten first: her parents, Enmon and Mena, say a touching goodbye to their daughter and thank you. Following the quest marker, this scene is easy to miss.

items.title: Children's Pets
items.location: The house where your adopted children live
items.description: An adopted child may bring home a wild pet: Biter the skeever, Cotton the rabbit, Kit the fox, Pincer the mudcrab or Vix the snow fox. The skeever is considered one of the rarest.
tips: Answering "Absolutely not. No pets. Ever." stops them asking for a new one for 15 days
If you kill the pet, the child will not talk to you for a few days

items.title: Orthjolf's Elf Greeting
items.location: Castle Volkihar (Dawnguard, vampire side)
items.description: Orthjolf and Vingalmo bicker constantly. On first meeting, Orthjolf rails against elves, but if you are an elf yourself he has other lines: Vingalmo is already sizing you up, and "you'll find his fangs in your neck".

items.title: If Camilla Dies
items.location: Riverwood, the Riverwood Trader
items.description: If Camilla Valerius dies after walking you to the bridge, Lucan Valerius says a different line when you return the Golden Claw: he regrets that his sister did not live to see it.

items.title: Roggvir's Execution Skipped
items.location: Solitude after the Battle for Solitude (Stormcloaks)
items.description: If you never enter Solitude before the final civil war battle, you will not see Roggvir's execution. After the city is taken, Stormcloak soldiers say a unique line: a shame Roggvir was executed before they arrived.

items.title: The Sadri Family
items.location: Windhelm (Sadri's Used Wares, House of Clan Shatter-Shield), Raven Rock, Castle Volkihar
items.description: Revyn Sadri and Idesa Sadri are brother and sister, as the game data confirms. Two more Dunmer share the Sadri name, Geldis (the inn in Raven Rock) and the vampire Feran (Castle Volkihar), but their relation is unknown.
